0022600222.text: The Lakers (10-2, first in the Pacific and the West, on a six-game winning streak) head to Milwaukee for their 13th game of the season, after going 8-2 in their last ten, while the Bucks (1-10, 15th in the East) have lost seven straight. Quentin Grimes is out for Los Angeles with a finger injury, while Milwaukee is missing Myles Turner (out, rest) and Tyler Herro (day-to-day, knee bruise, game-time decision). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with the most recent meeting a 105-101 Lakers loss in Los Angeles on January 9, 2026, and they have not played each other yet in 2026-27.
